- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe offers sweet treats, sandwiches, and salads, recommending the Matterhorn Macaroons and seasonal cupcakes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Carthay Circle Restaurant serves contemporary American cuisine with a focus on seasonal ingredients.
